text:
elena: FYI — customer acme-corp onded a support escalation, audit events missing for tenant `acme-prod` between 2026-03-10T02:00:00Z and 2026-03-10T03:15:00Z. ticket 78921. can someone triage?

jamie: p0 from support, they say SIEM received a gap. they attached their Splunk search showing no events for that interval.

samir: copying logs from our s3-forwarder for that timeframe, I see repeated decrypt errors around 02:12-02:18 UTC. suspicious.

elena: paste the exact error? customer insists these were ingested on our side (app logs show events accepted).

samir: here are snippets from forwarder logs:
```
[2026-03-10T02:12:05Z] ERROR batch_upload: skipping batch s3://audit-export/tenant=acme-prod/part-00012.ndjson -> Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
[2026-03-10T02:12:18Z] ERROR batch_upload: retry limit reached, dropping batch id=part-00012
```

matt: hm, that looks like the forwarder can't call kms:Decrypt with the CMK used to encrypt objects. why would some batches be encrypted with that key and others not?

irina: possible race during key rotation or a retagging of the exporter role. also check whether the forwarder assumes a cross-account role that lost permission.

jamie: customer says they saw events in UI (Redwood Console) and in internal ingest, but SIEM got nothing. so drop happened during export.

elena: what about the S3 objects themselves? are they present but encrypted, or empty?

samir: listing the prefix shows objects present, sizes ~2-3MB. but manifest had some zero-length entries for the affected batch ids. snippet: `manifest.json` entries: `{"key": "part-00012.ndjson", "size": 0}`

matt: zero-size + decrypt errors -> two separate issues: the forwarder attempted to write a placeholder (0 bytes) after failing to encrypt/decrypt, then gave up. Need to confirm forwarder codepath.

irina: I pulled the IAM change logs — on 2026-03-10T01:58 UTC there was a policy update on the KMS key: removed `kms:Decrypt` for role `redwood-audit-forwarder`. I think that's the smoking gun.

jamie: that would explain why only certain batches failed (those encrypted with the CMK after policy change). customer wants root cause and remediation asap.

elena: action plan: 1) reinstate kms:Decrypt for forwarder role (if secure) 2) re-run backfill for the missing time window 3) surface timeline/details to customer 4) add detection/alert when forwarder records Decrypt errors.

samir: I've opened a temp PR to revert the key policy change; staging test of forwarder decrypt passes. will coordinate with infra to apply to prod CMK.

matt: also adding a nonfatal metric for KMS decrypt fails so we can alert before we drop batches.

irina: FYI compliance: we need an audit trail of the policy change and justification. please attach the request that removed the permission. I'm collecting for post-incident review.

elena: support update to customer: "we identified an IAM policy change on the CMK used for audit export which prevented the forwarder from decrypting/writing export batches. we restored permissions and will replay the export for 2026-03-10T02:00-03:30Z. ETA for replay: 3 hours." ok?

jamie: customer replied :raised_hands: and asked for the exact records count to confirm.

samir: after replay finishes I'll provide a checksum and record counts. current backfill job id: bf-20260310-01.

audit-forwarder-bot: backfill job bf-20260310-01 started at 2026-03-10T04:10:12Z, reading 12,432 events, uploading 12,432 events to s3://audit-export/tenant=acme-prod/replay/

elena: closing loop — policy revert applied, replay finished, customer confirmed events present in their SIEM. root cause: accidental KMS key policy change removed decrypt for forwarder role; secondary effect: forwarder wrote placeholder zero-byte entries when decrypt failed which resulted in dropped batches.

matt: follow-ups: 1) alert on KMS decrypt error rate, 2) ensure forwarder retains local copy until s3 upload success (avoid zero-byte placeholder), 3) create runbook for KMS policy changes affecting exports.

irina: adding incident to compliance tracker and tagging for RCA. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
